cim_eredeti: Artificial intelligence is rewriting art history: Modern technologies are revealing the secrets of ancient paintings
szoveg_eredeti:
London, UK – Artificial intelligence is opening new horizons for researchers and historians to unravel the mysteries of historical artworks.

Advanced digital technologies are now capable of analyzing minute details

within ancient paintings, revealing information that may help identify the true artists.

These technologies also aid in understanding the conditions under which these works were created.

The study of paintings no longer relies solely on visual examination and the traditional expertise of specialists.

Algorithms and machine learning techniques have entered the field of analyzing colors,

features, brushstrokes, and artistic compositions.

This allows for extensive comparisons between works attributed to different artists.

These technologies help detect subtle features that the human eye might not easily perceive,

such as color distribution, brushstroke patterns, and details hidden beneath layers of paint.

This contributes to the re-evaluation of works whose identity or artistic attribution has been disputed for years.

Artificial intelligence can also compare unknown paintings with documented works by well-known artists,

analyzing similarities and differences to provide scientific indicators that support expert research.

This is especially important in cases lacking clear historical documentation.

The role of technology extends to the use of advanced imaging techniques,

X-rays, and materials analysi Through these methods,

preliminary sketches and modifications made by artists before the final version of the painting can be revealed.

This gives researchers the opportunity to understand the stages of artistic creation more precisely.

Despite these capabilities, relying solely on artificial intelligence to identify paintings is still insufficient.

The results require review by art, restoration, and history experts,

along with an examination of the materials and documentation associated with the work.

This will help avoid erroneous conclusions.

The introduction of artificial intelligence into this field raises important questions about the future of documenting

artistic heritage and its ability to resolve historical disputes regarding the attribution of paintings.

Furthermore, artificial intelligence contributes to the rediscovery of works

that may have remained unknown or attributed to other artists.

Between human expertise and technological advancement, the art world seems poised for a new era of research and discovery.

This era may contribute to a reinterpretation of the history of famous paintings,

revealing secrets that have remained hidden within their colors and layers for decades or even centuries.
